scenario: New applications arriving in the careers@ Gmail inbox are matched to the open requisition in the ATS by job code or title, the candidate record is created, and the hiring manager listed on the requisition is notified in Slack.
rule_hooks: requisition-to-hiring-manager mapping sheet

scenario: Employee referral form submissions are checked against existing ATS candidates for duplicates, tagged as referrals with the referring employee, and routed to the recruiter who owns that department.
rule_hooks: duplicate check, recruiter-by-department table

scenario: Resumes emailed by staffing agencies are checked for an active signed agency agreement and for whether the candidate was already in the ATS within 6 months; unowned or unauthorized submissions get a polite rejection reply.
rule_hooks: agency contract list, 6-month ownership window

scenario: Candidate emails asking to reschedule interviews are matched to the calendar event, and the coordinator for that interview loop gets a helpdesk ticket marked urgent if the interview is within 48 hours.
rule_hooks: time-to-interview thresholds, coordinator assignment

scenario: Offer approval requests submitted in the HR ticketing queue are compared with the salary band for the role and level; in-band offers go to the department head, out-of-band offers additionally go to the compensation lead and CFO.
rule_hooks: salary band sheet, approval chain by variance

scenario: Background check vendor result emails are parsed for status (clear, consider, pending); clear results update the candidate record and notify the recruiter, while 'consider' results open a confidential ticket for the HR compliance specialist to start adverse action review.
rule_hooks: result status codes, adverse action process

scenario: Signed offer notifications in DocuSign trigger reading the start date and role, then creating IT equipment and access tickets assigned to the correct IT queue based on office location and role type.
rule_hooks: location-to-IT-queue map, role access templates

scenario: New-hire I-9 document submissions in the HR helpdesk are checked against start dates; tickets missing Section 2 verification by day 3 are escalated to the HR ops manager and the new hire's manager is pinged.
rule_hooks: I-9 3-business-day rule

scenario: Messages posted in the #new-hire-help Slack channel are classified by topic (payroll, benefits, IT, facilities, policies) and turned into tickets for the matching team, with an auto-reply linking the relevant onboarding FAQ.
rule_hooks: topic keywords, team ownership matrix

scenario: Resignation emails forwarded to hr@ are read for the employee's name and last day, the employee's record in the HRIS is flagged, and offboarding tasks are assigned to IT, payroll and the manager with due dates relative to the last day.
rule_hooks: offboarding checklist, notice period lead times

scenario: Termination requests submitted by managers in the HR case system are prioritized as same-day and routed to the HRBP and IT security for immediate access revocation, while voluntary exits follow the standard queue.
rule_hooks: termination type, same-day access revocation policy

scenario: Offboarding tickets are tagged with the employee's work state and the payroll team is assigned a final-paycheck task due by the state-mandated deadline, with California and other immediate-pay states marked critical.
rule_hooks: state final-pay deadline table

scenario: Time-off requests submitted via form are checked against the employee's PTO balance in the sheet and the team calendar for overlapping absences; requests within balance and below the team overlap limit are routed to the manager for approval, others flagged with the reason.
rule_hooks: PTO balance, max concurrent absences per team

scenario: Time-off requests from finance and support staff falling in quarter-end or peak-season blackout windows are auto-replied with the policy and escalated to the department director for exception approval.
rule_hooks: department blackout calendar

scenario: Emails or tickets mentioning medical leave, parental leave or FMLA are identified, routed confidentially to the leave administrator, and the employee gets a reply with the correct leave packet based on their state and tenure eligibility.
rule_hooks: FMLA eligibility (12 months/1250 hours), state leave rules

scenario: Early-morning sick call-out messages to the shift-supervisor Slack channel are logged in the attendance sheet, the supervisor of that shift is notified, and employees exceeding the occurrence threshold are flagged to HR.
rule_hooks: attendance occurrence points policy

scenario: Payroll-system alerts for timesheets with missing punches, overtime over 10 hours, or unapproved entries before the payroll cutoff are routed to the responsible manager, with unresolved items escalated to the payroll specialist.
rule_hooks: payroll cutoff time, overtime thresholds

scenario: Payroll change requests (direct deposit, tax withholding, address) arriving in the payroll helpdesk are classified, and those received after the cycle cutoff are tagged for the next cycle with a reply stating the effective pay date.
rule_hooks: payroll calendar cutoffs

scenario: Employee tickets reporting a missing or incorrect paycheck are prioritized by severity (no pay received is P1, small deduction questions P3) and assigned to the payroll analyst for the employee's pay group.
rule_hooks: severity rubric, pay-group ownership

scenario: Garnishment and child support orders received by email or fax-to-email are logged, matched to the employee in the HRIS, and routed to the payroll compliance lead with a deadline based on the order's required response date.
rule_hooks: order type, legal response deadlines

scenario: Benefits change requests citing marriage, birth or loss of coverage are checked for the 30-day qualifying-event window; in-window requests go to the benefits specialist with a document checklist, late requests get a reply explaining they must wait for open enrollment.
rule_hooks: 30-day QLE window, required documentation

scenario: During open enrollment, questions arriving in the benefits inbox are tagged by plan type (medical, dental, FSA/HSA, 401k), answered with the matching plan FAQ when simple, and escalated to the broker contact for claims or coverage disputes.
rule_hooks: plan-type tags, broker escalation criteria

scenario: Weekly eligibility discrepancy reports emailed by the insurance carrier are reconciled against HRIS enrollments, and each mismatch is opened as a ticket for the benefits admin with the affected employee and coverage dates.
rule_hooks: HRIS vs carrier enrollment comparison

scenario: Termination and reduced-hours events in the HRIS feed are triaged for COBRA eligibility, and qualifying cases are sent to the COBRA administrator within the 30-day notification window with the event date and covered dependents.
rule_hooks: COBRA qualifying events, notification deadlines

scenario: Tuition reimbursement submissions are checked for pre-approval, passing grades and the annual cap; complete in-policy claims are sent to payroll for reimbursement and others are returned with the specific missing item.
rule_hooks: annual reimbursement cap, grade minimum, pre-approval

scenario: LMS completion exports for mandatory harassment-prevention and security training are read, overdue employees get a reminder email, and those over 14 days overdue are escalated to their manager in Slack.
rule_hooks: due dates, escalation tiers by days overdue

scenario: Requests to attend external conferences or courses are routed based on cost: under $500 to the manager, $500–$2,000 to the department head, and above that to the L&D director with budget remaining for the department checked first.
rule_hooks: cost approval tiers, department training budget

scenario: Expiring licenses and certifications (nursing licenses, forklift certifications, CPA) tracked in the credentials sheet are triaged by days until expiry, with renewal reminders to employees and work-restriction notices to managers for anything already expired.
rule_hooks: credential expiry dates, role requirements

scenario: Manager requests for performance-review deadline extensions are checked against the review cycle calendar; short extensions are auto-approved and logged, while requests past calibration date go to the HRBP.
rule_hooks: review cycle milestones, max extension days

scenario: Manager emails requesting to start a performance improvement plan are routed to the assigned HRBP for the department, with a check for prior documented warnings in the employee file and a flag if none exist.
rule_hooks: progressive discipline steps, HRBP assignment

scenario: Mid-cycle promotion and pay-adjustment requests are checked for minimum time in role and the merit budget remaining, then routed to compensation for review or returned to the manager with the unmet criterion.
rule_hooks: time-in-role minimum, merit budget

scenario: Submissions to the employee concerns form are classified by type (harassment, discrimination, safety, interpersonal conflict, policy question); harassment and discrimination cases are routed confidentially to the ER investigator within 24 hours and excluded from the general queue.
rule_hooks: complaint type severity, confidentiality routing

scenario: Reports forwarded from the third-party ethics hotline are routed based on the allegation category and whether the subject is an executive, in which case they go to the audit committee chair rather than HR leadership.
rule_hooks: allegation categories, conflict-of-interest routing

scenario: Requests for workplace accommodations (disability, religious, pregnancy) are detected in HR tickets, moved to a restricted queue for the accommodations coordinator, and the employee receives an acknowledgment with the interactive-process timeline.
rule_hooks: ADA/PWFA request types, restricted access

scenario: Employment and income verification requests from lenders and landlords arriving in the HR inbox are checked for a signed employee authorization; authorized requests are answered with dates and title only per policy, and salary verification is routed to payroll.
rule_hooks: authorization requirement, disclosure policy

scenario: State unemployment claim notices are matched to the former employee's separation record and routed to the HR generalist with the response deadline, with misconduct terminations flagged for contest review.
rule_hooks: separation reason, state response deadlines

scenario: Workplace injury reports submitted by supervisors are logged, the insurance carrier first report of injury is triggered within the required window, and incidents involving hospitalization are flagged as OSHA-reportable within 24 hours to the safety manager.
rule_hooks: OSHA reporting thresholds, carrier filing windows

scenario: Employee requests about H-1B extensions, green card sponsorship or visa status changes are routed to the immigration counsel queue, with cases where status expires within 120 days marked high priority.
rule_hooks: visa expiration dates, case-type priority

scenario: HR helpdesk tickets requesting name changes, emergency contact updates or job title corrections are classified by required documentation; self-service-eligible changes get a reply with instructions while legal name changes are assigned to HR ops with a document request.
rule_hooks: change type, documentation requirements

scenario: Questions submitted via the anonymous form for the monthly all-hands are categorized by topic, routed to the responsible executive for answer prep, and any naming individuals or raising complaints are diverted to the ER team instead of the public Q&A.
rule_hooks: topic-to-executive owner, sensitive-content filter

scenario: When a candidate emails the recruiting inbox to withdraw, the agent finds their active application in the ATS, moves it to Withdrawn with a reason code, cancels any pending interviews on interviewer calendars, and alerts the recruiter and hiring manager in Slack, flagging when the req has a silver-medalist backup worth reactivating.
rule_hooks: withdrawal reason codes, interview-stage cancellation rules, backup candidate list

scenario: Hiring managers submit new-headcount request forms, and the agent checks each against the approved headcount plan sheet. Budgeted backfills go straight to recruiting ops to open the req; net-new roles route to Finance and the department VP for approval, and requests missing a cost center are bounced back.
rule_hooks: headcount plan, backfill vs net-new, approval matrix by department

scenario: Employees apply to internal postings through a form, and the agent checks each applicant's HRIS record for minimum tenure in role and the absence of an active PIP or written warning. Eligible applicants go to the recruiter and their current manager is notified; ineligible ones get a policy-based reply.
rule_hooks: internal mobility eligibility (tenure, performance status), manager-notification policy

scenario: Completed reference questionnaires arrive by email from a reference-check vendor. The agent attaches each to the candidate record, marks the reference step complete when the required count is met, and escalates any reference with a 'would not rehire' answer or a low score to the recruiter before the offer goes out.
rule_hooks: required reference count by level, red-flag answers, score thresholds

scenario: New applications are matched against former-employee records in the HRIS. Applicants flagged not-eligible-for-rehire are held and routed to the HRBP; those inside the post-separation waiting period are flagged to the recruiter; eligible boomerangs are tagged so the recruiter can consider service-date bridging.
rule_hooks: rehire eligibility flag, separation reason, waiting period, service bridging rules

scenario: Career fair and info-session invitations from universities land in a shared inbox. The agent logs each in the campus recruiting sheet and assigns it to the university recruiter who owns that school. It declines events from non-target schools with a template, and flags events whose registration deadline is less than two weeks out.
rule_hooks: target school list, school-to-recruiter ownership, registration deadline lead time

scenario: Accepted candidates email asking to move their start date. The agent checks the new date against the onboarding cohort calendar (Mondays only), the IT equipment lead time, and the payroll cutoff. It approves compliant dates by updating the ATS and HRIS and notifying IT, routes the rest to the recruiter, and suggests the nearest valid date.
rule_hooks: allowed start days, cohort calendar, provisioning lead time, payroll cutoff

scenario: When an E-Verify Tentative Nonconfirmation case appears in the case-status emails, the agent creates a confidential HR ticket and notifies the onboarding specialist to deliver the further-action notice privately. It tracks the 8-federal-government-workday window for the employee to contest, and alerts HR compliance as that deadline approaches.
rule_hooks: TNC process steps, federal workday deadlines, confidentiality and anti-discrimination rules

scenario: New hires and transferees submit relocation requests, and the agent determines their relocation tier from job level and move distance. Requests within the package (lump sum or managed move) go to the relocation vendor; exceptions over the tier cap go to the comp team. Each employee is reminded that the repayment agreement must be signed first.
rule_hooks: relocation tiers by level and distance, caps, repayment agreement requirement

scenario: New-hire and employee-submitted state tax withholding forms arrive in the payroll inbox. The agent identifies the work and residence states from the HRIS, sends forms for states with reciprocity agreements or local taxes to the payroll tax specialist, enters standard forms into the payroll ticket queue, and rejects outdated form versions with a link to the current one.
rule_hooks: state reciprocity agreements, local tax jurisdictions, current form versions

scenario: Managers submit end-of-probation forms marked pass, extend, or terminate. Passes are recorded in the HRIS and trigger benefits-waiting-period notifications; extensions within the allowed maximum are approved and the review date is updated; terminations and any extension beyond the cap route to the HRBP with priority.
rule_hooks: probation length policy, maximum extension, benefits waiting period

scenario: The returns vendor sends shipment-tracking and receipt emails for departing employees' laptop return boxes. The agent matches each email to an offboarding record and marks equipment received. Employees past 14 days with no shipment get a reminder; anyone past 30 days goes to IT asset management and payroll for a deduction review where state law allows it.
rule_hooks: return deadline days, asset list per employee, state wage-deduction restrictions

scenario: Exit survey responses are scanned for flagged themes. Comments alleging harassment, discrimination, or retaliation are routed to employee relations; manager-specific complaints go to the HRBP for that org; compensation themes are logged to a comp feedback sheet. Each response is tagged for the quarterly attrition report.
rule_hooks: theme taxonomy, mandatory ER escalation topics, org-to-HRBP mapping

scenario: When a resignation is processed, the agent checks whether the departing employee received a sign-on or relocation bonus inside the clawback window. It calculates the prorated repayment owed and routes the case to payroll for a final-check deduction where state law permits, or to finance for invoicing where it doesn't.
rule_hooks: clawback window and proration schedule, state deduction rules, signed repayment agreement

scenario: Bereavement leave requests from the time-off form are checked against the relationship tier table, for example 5 days for immediate family and 3 for extended family. The agent auto-approves in-policy requests in the time system, notifies the manager, and routes requests for extra days or uncovered relationships to the HR generalist. It also flags employees in states with mandated bereavement leave for state-specific handling.
rule_hooks: relationship tier days, state bereavement mandates, manager notification

scenario: Employees upload jury duty summonses, and the agent logs the dates as jury duty leave and notifies the manager. It determines paid versus unpaid days from the employee's work state and exempt status, then sends payroll the pay instructions. Summonses arriving during critical periods are flagged so the employee can request a deferral letter.
rule_hooks: state jury duty pay laws, exempt vs non-exempt pay rules, company paid-day cap

scenario: Non-exempt employees submit overtime pre-approval requests through a form. The agent checks the department's remaining OT budget in the tracking sheet and the employee's weekly scheduled hours. Requests under the threshold auto-route to the direct manager; requests that would push the weekly total over 60 hours, or the department over budget, go to the department head.
rule_hooks: OT budget by department, weekly hour thresholds, approval chain

scenario: Hourly staff post shift-swap requests in a Slack channel. The agent verifies that both employees hold the role certification the shift needs, that the swap doesn't create daily or weekly overtime or break minimum rest between shifts, and that it doesn't violate predictive-scheduling notice rules in covered cities. It approves valid swaps in the scheduling sheet and explains rejections.
rule_hooks: role certifications, OT thresholds, minimum rest, predictive scheduling ordinances

scenario: Direct deposit change requests that arrive by email are screened for fraud signals: sender not matching the email on file, a new bank in the same week as a password reset, or urgent language near payday. The agent holds flagged requests, opens a payroll security ticket requiring a callback to the phone number on file, and sends clean requests to the self-service instructions.
rule_hooks: fraud indicator checklist, email-on-file match, payroll cutoff timing

scenario: Managers submit spot bonus nominations. The agent checks the award amount against approval thresholds (under $500 needs manager-plus-one, over $500 needs the VP), the employee's year-to-date award total against the annual cap, and the department's remaining recognition budget. It routes each nomination for approval and sends approved awards to payroll for the next run.
rule_hooks: award amount tiers, per-employee annual cap, departmental budget

scenario: Sales reps file commission dispute tickets, and the agent categorizes each: missing deal credit, split disagreement, rate error, or payment timing. It checks the CRM for deal close dates and owners, routes crediting and split disputes to sales ops and payment errors to payroll, and flags disputes filed past the plan's 60-day dispute window.
rule_hooks: comp plan dispute window, dispute categories, CRM deal ownership

scenario: Employees email HR about their 401(k). The agent sends hardship withdrawal and loan requests to the recordkeeper portal with instructions, and routes contribution-change requests that miss the payroll cutoff to payroll with an effective-date note. Questions about missing employer match or true-up go to the benefits specialist, with highly compensated employees flagged for limit review.
rule_hooks: request type routing, payroll cutoff, match formula, HCE and IRS contribution limits

scenario: During a dependent eligibility audit, employees upload documents such as marriage certificates, birth certificates, and tax returns. The agent checks each document type against the acceptable-documents list for the dependent's relationship, marks dependents verified in the audit tracker, emails specific rejection reasons, and gives benefits ops the list of dependents still unverified at the deadline for termination.
rule_hooks: acceptable document matrix by relationship, audit deadline, coverage termination rules

scenario: Employees submit wellness stipend reimbursement claims for gym memberships, fitness apps, and equipment. The agent checks each expense category against the eligible list, the employee's remaining annual balance, and the 90-day submission window. It approves eligible claims to payroll as taxable income and denies ineligible ones with the policy reference.
rule_hooks: eligible expense categories, annual stipend cap, submission window, taxability

scenario: Employees returning from medical leave send fitness-for-duty or return-to-work notes. The agent updates the leave case's return date, notifies the manager and payroll to reactivate pay, and routes any note with work restrictions to the accommodation team. If no clearance arrives by the scheduled return date, it escalates to the leave specialist.
rule_hooks: clearance requirement by leave type, restriction detection, scheduled return dates

scenario: When the HRIS records a promotion or hire into a people-manager role, the agent enrolls the person in manager onboarding training. It also assigns state-mandated supervisor harassment-prevention training (for example, California's 2-hour course within 6 months, or New York's annual course) based on work location, and notifies the new manager of the due dates.
rule_hooks: state supervisor training mandates, due-date windows, manager-role triggers

scenario: After a handbook update goes out, the agent reads replies to the acknowledgment email. Clean acknowledgments are marked complete in the tracking sheet; replies with questions go to the policy owner; replies that refuse to sign or raise legal objections go to the HR director. Non-responders past the deadline are listed for manager follow-up.
rule_hooks: acknowledgment deadline, policy owner mapping, escalation criteria for objections

scenario: Learning platform tickets are classified as SSO/login failures (to IT), missing course assignments (to the L&D admin), completion not recorded (to the L&D admin with the vendor cc'd), or content questions (to the course owner). Tickets about compliance courses due within 7 days are raised to high priority.
rule_hooks: issue category routing, compliance course list, due-date priority rules

scenario: Mentorship program signup forms from mentees and mentors are matched by function, by a level gap of at least two levels, and by the rule that mentor and mentee are not in the same reporting chain. The agent caps each mentor at three mentees, emails introductions for matches, and waitlists unmatched mentees with a note to the program coordinator.
rule_hooks: level gap rule, reporting-chain exclusion, mentor capacity cap

scenario: After calibration closes, managers submit requests to change a final performance rating. The agent compares the proposed rating with the calibrated one and the org's rating distribution targets. One-step changes go to the HRBP; two-step changes, or changes that push the org outside distribution guardrails, go to the division VP. Every request is logged for the comp cycle lock.
rule_hooks: rating delta thresholds, distribution guardrails, comp cycle lock date

scenario: Managers request off-cycle salary increases, for example for retention or market adjustments. The agent pulls the employee's salary band and compa-ratio and checks the percentage requested. Requests within 5% that stay under the band midpoint go to the HRBP; larger increases, above-max salaries, or anyone with a raise in the last 6 months go to the comp committee queue.
rule_hooks: salary bands and compa-ratio, percent thresholds, recency of last increase

scenario: Open-text comments from the engagement survey are scanned for safety threats, self-harm, harassment, or legal violations. The agent escalates those to ER, or to the EAP protocol for self-harm, and routes general themes to org leaders only when the team meets the minimum respondent threshold that preserves anonymity.
rule_hooks: mandatory escalation categories, anonymity minimum group size, org-leader mapping

scenario: Drug test results from the screening vendor and MRO are routed by test reason (pre-employment, post-accident, reasonable suspicion, or random DOT pool). Negatives clear the candidate or employee in the tracker. Non-negatives go to the safety manager for DOT roles or to the HRBP otherwise. Results for marijuana-only positives in states with off-duty cannabis protections are flagged for legal review.
rule_hooks: test reason, DOT vs non-DOT role, state cannabis employment laws

scenario: Employees request to work from another state or country, either temporarily or permanently. The agent checks the destination against the list of states where the company is registered for payroll tax, and checks the duration against the 30-day threshold. Requests to registered states under the threshold go to the manager; new states go to payroll tax; international requests go to legal and global mobility.
rule_hooks: registered payroll states, duration thresholds, international work restrictions

scenario: Employees submit outside employment and moonlighting disclosure forms. The agent checks the outside employer against the competitor and vendor list in the CRM and the employee's role sensitivity. Non-conflicting side jobs are approved and logged; work for a competitor, a vendor, or a customer goes to legal and the employee's VP for a conflict-of-interest review.
rule_hooks: competitor/vendor/customer lists, role sensitivity, conflict-of-interest policy

scenario: Grievances filed by shop stewards arrive by email. The agent logs each in the grievance tracker with the CBA article cited, assigns it to the labor relations rep for that bargaining unit, and calculates the step-1 response deadline from the contract. It also alerts the rep when a grievance was filed past the contractual filing window, since that may be grounds to deny it as untimely.
rule_hooks: CBA step deadlines, filing windows, bargaining unit to rep mapping

scenario: Subpoenas and legal records requests for employee files arrive by email or fax scan. The agent logs the response deadline, routes each to in-house legal with the matching employee record identified, and places a legal hold flag on the employee's file. It also notifies the HR records custodian, without sending any records until legal approves.
rule_hooks: response deadlines, legal hold procedures, records custodian rules

scenario: Current and former employees request copies of their personnel files or payroll records. The agent determines the state-law response deadline from the work location (for example, 30 days in California), logs the request, and assigns it to the records team. It routes requests from attorneys, or from people with open ER cases, to the HRBP and legal first.
rule_hooks: state personnel file access laws and deadlines, open-case checks, requester type

scenario: Managers request converting a contractor or contingent worker to a full-time employee. The agent checks the contractor's tenure and the agency's conversion-fee terms in the vendor contract, confirms open headcount in the plan sheet, and routes each request to recruiting for a req. Contractors engaged over 12 months, or whose duties match employee roles, are flagged to legal for misclassification review.
rule_hooks: headcount plan, agency conversion fees, tenure thresholds, misclassification criteria

scenario: Notices from state and federal tax agencies (SUI rate changes, withholding discrepancies, penalty assessments, new-account registrations) arrive in the payroll inbox. The agent classifies each by notice type and due date and forwards rate changes to the payroll provider. Penalty and discrepancy notices go to the payroll tax manager with priority based on days until the response deadline.
rule_hooks: notice type taxonomy, agency response deadlines, provider vs in-house responsibility
